title: Works Really Well!
body: I think it would also be really nice to have the option to add a note or specific value to a habit for each day. For example, if “walking” is a habit, you could record that you walked 5k one day, 7k the next, etc. It would be great to be able to save that data and see that kind of progress over time, rather than only being able to mark the habit as completed. I think it would add a lot of value to the habit-tracking experience!
author: Jana0303
